title: Apartment or commercial property in Dushanbe: calculating rental yield
excerpt: A comparison method for buyers: expenses, vacancy, contracts and net income. The example is hypothetical; sale listings cannot establish an actual market rental yield.
contentHtml:
Substantively updated on 15 October 2026.

Compare properties by expected net income and risk, not just a promised rent. A sale catalog shows asking prices; it does not prove actual rent, occupancy or future capital appreciation.

Gross and net yield

A simplified gross yield is annual rent divided by the purchase price, multiplied by 100%. For a net calculation, use the realistically expected number of paid months, deduct expenses and divide the result by all invested funds: purchase, preparation and closing. With borrowing, calculate cash flow after lender payments separately. Do not mix rental income with an assumption that the property will later sell for more.

Illustration, not a Dushanbe market rate

Assume a purchase price of 800,000 somoni and an advertised rent of 5,000 per month. The nominal gross calculation gives 7.5% over 12 months. Eleven paid months produce 55,000. With hypothetical annual expenses of 12,000 and total invested funds of 850,000, the result before any uncounted costs is 43,000 / 850,000, or about 5.1%. Every number is an assumption to explain the formula, not evidence of local rent or a tax rate.

Questions about an apartment

Check renovation and furniture condition, recurring building charges, possible vacancy between tenants and a renewal budget. If the seller cites rental income, request evidence of actual payments under an existing lease. An advertisement or verbal promise does not replace that information.

Questions about commercial premises

Clarify permitted use, access, utilities, fit-out requirements and the contract term. Establish who pays for preparation, maintenance and reinstatement, how rent changes and what happens if a tenant leaves early. A higher advertised rent does not establish lower risk.

Making a decision

Prepare a base and an adverse scenario for each property: fewer paid months, extra works and delayed handover. Clarify applicable taxes and paperwork with a qualified professional. If the figures work only with no vacancy or costs, the margin is inadequate. See current sale offers when selecting a property to buy; this article does not promise rental or management services.

faq.q: What rental yield is guaranteed in Dushanbe?
faq.a: We do not claim a guaranteed yield. Evidence of actual payments, expenses and vacancy for the particular property is needed, not only its sale price.

faq.q: Why is commercial property not always better than an apartment?
faq.a: Preparation costs, lease terms, tenant search time and vacancy all matter. A high advertised rent alone does not determine the net result.
